author: Matt Walsh
description:
Today on the Matt Walsh Show, chaos erupts south of the border as Mexico descends further into anarchy and violence. What if anything should the United States do about this, to protect its own citizens? Also Gavin Newsom says that Democrats need to be more "culturally normal." But is that even fundamentally possible for the modern Democrat party? And the education system has spent many billions of dollars replacing books with screens for students. The results are in, and they are catastrophic.
